$comment: The pinned herdr target. api-schema.json in this directory is the ONLY permitted source for herdr client codegen (OSADE.md §4.1). backend/ is reference reading for behaviour, never for API derivation.

identity.$comment: herdr's version string is NOT a contract. Two builds both report 0.8.2 with different protocols and a 10-method gap (PRD-DELTA #1). The identity of a herdr target is the tuple (protocol, method set), and the version string is a label. Directory names are <version>-p<protocol> for that reason.

binary.$comment: NOT YET VENDORED. This records the binary the schema was captured from so the checksum can be verified when packaging lands in M0. Do not treat a matching checksum as the only gate — run the boot drift check (OSADE.md §4.1.1) regardless, because a user may have a different herdr on PATH.
binary.todo: M0 packaging: fetch per-platform release binaries into this directory, record a sha256 per target, verify at boot (OSADE.md §18.1).

known_gaps.$comment: Methods present in backend/src/api/schema.rs but absent from this pinned schema. Calling any of these against this target returns invalid_request. See PRD-DELTA #1.
